name: Dyn_World_IntegratePositions
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_inputs. Outlined block of 00C5BB30 with the world in EBX and dt on the stack, body 00C5B1B0-00C5BB29, called at 00C5C491 inside the rdtsc profiler scope whose image label is 'UpdatePosition' (00C50390 call at 00C5C469). Gated on B+50h bit 4, over the world body list at world+204h (sentinel world+208h, next at body+84h). pos += (v+linearBias)*dt; the angular velocity plus its bias is scaled by 100.0 (float of the double 00D7A220), and when its magnitude exceeds the float 1e-5 at 00D7A310 rows 2 and 1 are rotated by Rodrigues through FSIN/FCOS with angle = mag*dt/100, then row2 is normalised, row0 = row1 x row2 normalised and row1 = row2 x row0, so the basis is right-handed by construction. Then damping again, the two speed clamps against M+18h and M+1Ch, the sleep countdown at B+54h against world+3Ch/+40h/+44h with the 0.9 scale at 00D7A390 and flag bit 1, and finally M+38h, M+44h, M+20h and M+2Ch are all zeroed - the force accumulators are cleared every substep. docs/RIGID_BODY_INTEGRATION.md | Run-time evidence, packet cc_exe_2j (bsp_game.exe milestone 2j): run per unit per fixed simulation step in bsp_game.exe, 8960 times over the USN02 mission. It is what turns the velocities the motion tick writes into a pose there; the controlled DeRuyter reaches 16.454 forward speed and -20.302 degrees of heading in 14.00 s of simulated time. M+18h and M+1Ch had to be set out of range by the host, because no producer for either clamp is known and a zero would zero the velocity on the first substep. docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2j.
